body:
I was prescribed Abilify and Prozac (for Major Depressive Disorder), the Abilify was prescribed as an anti-psychotic, I was instructed to take 5mg a day for a week then 10 for a week then to take 20mg until I ran out.
After increasing my dosage to 10mg I noticed I had an extreme urge to just move, if I really focused all my energy into just doing something else that required me to sit still I was able to do it. Was very productive at work and cleaning my house.
Not an entirely enjoyable experience. I was also drinking a can of monster energy to go along with it, I was drinking one every day before taking the medication and did not notice these symptoms. Maybe the combo had something to do with it.
I still had these symptoms even after stopping the medication for 3 days.
